candidates.title: ConServe: Fine-Grained GPU Harvesting for LLM Online and Offline Co-Serving
candidates.reason: ICML-2026-lineage co-serving system with SLO-aware token-level scheduling, layer-wise preemption, and incremental KV checkpoint/prefetch. It directly addresses harvesting stranded GPU capacity while preserving online latency and has strong end-to-end evaluation.

discovery_stats.axis: online/offline co-serving / fine-grained GPU harvesting / preemption
discovery_stats.query_summary: Switched from agent serving to independent co-serving/GPU-harvesting work. ConServe was surfaced through the kvcached/Prism ecosystem, and its arXiv identity was not found by repository code search.
discovery_stats.next_axis_hint: Inspect independent GPU isolation/sharing systems or older high-value omissions, then run empty-round checks on unrelated axes.
